content:
Apple TV just announced the release date for Brothers, a new comedy series starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson. Here are the details.

Brothers is new Apple TV show starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson

Apple TV has some exciting comedy premieres happening soon, including Ted Lasso’s highly anticipated return later this summer.

And today, the streamer added another high-profile comedy to its calendar: Brothers.

Brothers premieres Wednesday, September 23 with two episodes, followed by weekly releases through November 4.

The series showrunner is Lee Eisenberg, perhaps best known for his work on The Office and Jury Duty. Brothers stars Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson as fictionalized versions of themselves.

Here’s Apple’s official series summary:

The talent involved in Brothers makes the show one of Apple’s highest-profile premieres of the fall. All signs indicate it could be a strong addition to Apple TV’s excellent slate of comedies.

Are you interested in watching Brothers when it premieres? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
